note: Canonical JSON manifest of the nine client manuscript forms committed under documents/forms/manuscripts (the .docx files are the source of record). `sourceText` is the canonical extracted text used for ingestion: coverage content is transcribed VERBATIM from the manuscript — no wording, dollar amount, notice period or defined term is paraphrased — while section-heading lines are rendered in the form-standard ALL-CAPS style so the shipped clause segmenter (backend/src/lib/forms/segmentation.ts) splits each section into its own citable clause. Ingested through the same segmentClauses + clauseTextHash pipeline the API uses. provenance is 'client' for every manuscript.

manuscripts.title: Cyber Incident Response Expense Coverage Extension
manuscripts.sourceText:
CYBER INCIDENT RESPONSE EXPENSE COVERAGE EXTENSION
Policy Number: __________
This endorsement modifies insurance provided under the Cyber Liability Coverage Form.
A. Coverage Grant
The Company shall reimburse the Insured for reasonable and necessary Incident Response Expenses incurred as a direct result of a Cyber Event first discovered during the Policy Period.
Incident Response Expenses include:
Digital forensic services
Legal consultation expenses
Public relations services
Notification expenses
Credit monitoring services
B. Limit of Insurance
The maximum amount payable under this endorsement shall not exceed $500,000 each Cyber Event and in the aggregate.
C. Exclusions
Coverage shall not apply to:
Failure to maintain minimum security controls disclosed in the application.
Any Cyber Event occurring prior to the Retroactive Date.
Intentional acts committed by executive management.

limits.name: Incident Response Expense
limits.basis: each Cyber Event and in the aggregate

manuscripts.title: Independent Director Liability Endorsement
manuscripts.modifies: Directors and Officers Liability Coverage Form
manuscripts.sourceText:
INDEPENDENT DIRECTOR LIABILITY ENDORSEMENT
A. Coverage
The Company shall pay Loss arising from Claims made against any Independent Director resulting from a Wrongful Act.
Coverage applies only after exhaustion of:
Corporate indemnification
Underlying D&O insurance
Excess D&O insurance
B. Additional Limit
An additional $5,000,000 limit shall apply solely to Independent Directors.
C. Non-Rescindable Provision
Coverage afforded to Independent Directors may not be rescinded except in cases of proven fraud committed by the Independent Director seeking coverage.
manuscripts.transcriptionNote: The manuscript states the three provisions as titled blocks (Coverage; Additional Limit; Non-Rescindable Provision). Rendered here as lettered sections A./B./C. in the endorsement house style; wording is verbatim.
